fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped Stack Model (kinetics + SOC ODE + Br crossover + thermal ODE)
source: Livshits et al. (2006) J. Power Sources 160, 1298-1301; Cho et al. (2012) J. Electrochem. Soc. 159, A1806-A1815; Tucker et al. (2015) J. Electrochem. Soc. 162, A2159-A2165; Kreutzer et al. (2012) J. Electrochem. Soc. 159, F331; Bard & Faulkner (2001) Electrochemical Methods

unit.name: Generic 30-cell H2-Br2 flow battery stack, 200 cm2 electrode area, high power density

A_cell.note: Active electrode area (Cho et al. 2012 cell scale)

E0.note: Standard cell potential Br2/Br- (+1.065 V SHE) vs H+/H2 (0 V SHE), activity-corrected ~1.09 V at 25 C
E0.source: Livshits et al. (2006); Tucker et al. (2015)

j0_Br_ref.note: Exchange current density of Br2/Br- couple at T_ref on carbon electrode; Br2 reduction is the rate-limiting (slow) electrode. Range 5e-3 to 5e-2 A/cm2.
j0_Br_ref.source: Cho et al. (2012); Kreutzer et al. (2012)

j0_H2_ref.note: Exchange current density of HOR/HER on Pt/C; very fast kinetics -> negligible H2 activation overpotential

E_act_Br.note: Activation energy of Br2/Br- kinetics (Arrhenius T-dependence of j0)

R_ohm_cm2_ref.note: Area-specific ohmic resistance at T_ref; HBrFB has low ASR (thin Nafion membrane + good contact) enabling high power density (~1 W/cm2)
R_ohm_cm2_ref.source: Cho et al. (2012) reported ASR ~0.4-0.6 Ohm.cm2

E_act_R.note: Activation energy for membrane/ohmic resistance (Nafion proton conductivity)
E_act_R.source: Cho et al. (2012); Tucker et al. (2015)

j_L.note: Limiting current density (Br2 mass transport at electrode at nominal flow); high due to forced convection

c_Br2_M.note: Bromine concentration in catholyte at SOC=1

k_cross.note: Lumped Br2 crossover rate constant (Br2 diffusion across membrane to H2 side, self-discharge). Calibrated so coulombic efficiency ~95-98% at rated current, consistent with reported HBrFB CE.
k_cross.source: Cho et al. (2012); Kreutzer et al. (2012) crossover-limited efficiency

pump_loss_coefficient.note: Parasitic pump power (electrolyte + H2 recirculation), P_pump = k_pump*I^2

cp_stack.note: Effective specific heat (aqueous HBr electrolyte dominated)

hA_cool.note: Lumped heat-transfer coefficient * area to coolant loop (sized to hold the stack within 20-60 C at rated heat load ~1 kW)

dOCV_dT.note: Reversible (entropic) temperature coefficient dE0/dT = -dS/(nF); -0.50 mV/K per cell
dOCV_dT.source: Livshits et al. (2006); Atkins Physical Chemistry HBr(aq) thermodynamics

current.note: positive=discharge, negative=charge; high current density allowed by fast H2 kinetics
